episodes.title: How a Cult Convinced 147 People to Sell Their Kidneys
episodes.description:
Between 2019 and 2023, a wellness influencer ran one of America's most disturbing cults—convincing hundreds of followers that selling their organs was "radical self-optimization." What started as a biohacking philosophy became a pipeline: victims were recruited through Instagram, isolated via Discord, and flown to unlicensed clinics in Mexico to have kidneys surgically removed for $180,000. The scheme netted $18.6 million before an undercover investigation by a health journalist exposed the entire operation. But the cult isn't gone—it's just changed its name, and it's still recruiting.

This is the true story of exploitation hidden in plain sight, the legal system's failure to protect victims, and how high-control groups use wellness language to normalize the unthinkable. Four donors died. Dozens more live with permanent kidney failure. And the masterminds may never face real consequences.

Watch as we uncover how this happened, who profited, and why the machine is still running.
